setup.zh: 三试在山门外。木笼里关着一只蠪侄——九尾九首，叫声像婴儿啼哭。笼门开了。
setup.en: The third trial is outside the gate. In a wooden cage crouches a Longzhi — nine tails, nine heads, a cry like a crying baby. The cage door opens.

recap.zh: 三试，胆子：山门外的一只蠪侄，你第一次斗法。
recap.en: Third trial, nerve: a Longzhi outside the gate — your first fight.

text.zh: 三试，胆子。降了它，或者被它降了。
text.en: Third, nerve. Subdue it — or be subdued.

exits.means: fights the Longzhi, takes the third trial

withdrawn.zh: 蠪侄缩回笼角，龇着牙。瞿老：「再来。」
withdrawn.en: The Longzhi shrinks back into its cage, teeth bared. Elder Qu: "Again."

text.zh: 腿短了点，脑子还行，胆子——胆子太大。进去吧。
text.en: Legs a little short, wits will do, nerve — too much nerve. Go in.
